summary_1line: Bhima and Karna engage in a furious duel; Bhima wounds and disarms Karna, who returns on another chariot as their deadly rivalry intensifies.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima, his body bristling with arrows like a porcupine and soaked in blood, stands blazing on his chariot while still firing at Karna.
Bhima smiling as he severs Karna’s bow, kills his horses and charioteer, and sends sun-bright arrows through Karna’s chest.
The white swan-colored horses of Karna’s chariot mingle with Bhima’s dark bear-colored steeds amid a storm of arrows.
